reason: Peak positions strongly support a triclinically strained spinel metric with primitive volume about 133.066 A^3, and the intensities plus plausible LiO4/NiO6 geometry favor normal over the tested fully inverse orderings. Exact recovery is not sufficiently established, however: the comparable Rwp is unavailable, while the trace's ad hoc whole-profile fit has RMSE about 0.545 intensity units versus a pattern MAD near 0.116. More importantly, it fixed all cation coordinates and all oxygen coordinates except one shared spinel parameter to an Fd-3m-derived framework; it did not refine or compare independent triclinic coordinates, occupancies, partial-inversion models, or competing symmetry-constrained realizations. The submitted CIF also declares P1 although its coordinates robustly detect as P-1, and its Z=1 convention obscures that the primitive cell contains Li2Ni4O8, i.e. two units of the supplied LiNi2O4 formula. A symmetry-consistent whole-pattern refinement and comparison of the unresolved coordinate/ordering possibilities is warranted.
